split_json_into_train_dev_test: run the script to split loose JSON data files into train, dev, and test splits
run_split_gpt2_json_cli: run split_gpt2_json.py with --input_files and --output_dir to split JSON corpora into train/dev/test
customize_split_percentages: run split_gpt2_json.py with --test_percent to customize the dev and test split ratios
review_get_splits_function: review the get_splits function that shuffles and partitions lines into train/dev/test splits
review_write_files_function: review the write_files function that writes split data and mapping files to the output directory
